card.architecture: Flux.2 rectified-flow DiT (Qwen3 encoder), NON-distilled base (bf16)
card.summary: FLUX.2-Klein 4B at full quality — the NON-distilled base (bf16) on 24 GB: 20 steps at real CFG 5 with negative prompts, higher fidelity than the 4-step distilled fp8 used on smaller cards. Qwen3 encoder, strong complex-prompt understanding.
card.pick_when: Newest fast, commercial, low-VRAM general model; good for complex prompts.

prompt.guidance: Long/complex prompts handled well by Qwen3; distilled, guidance 1.
prompt.example: A cozy reading nook by a rain-streaked window, a tabby cat asleep on a stack of books, warm lamplight, autumn leaves outside, soft painterly style
prompt.overview: FLUX.2 reads prompts like an LLM (Qwen3 encoder): rich natural-language prose (or JSON), most important elements first; no negative prompts.
prompt.instructions: Structure prompts as Subject + Action + Style + Context. Word order matters -- FLUX.2 weights what comes first (Main subject > Key action > Critical style > Essential context > Secondary details). Length: short 10-30 words (quick concepts), medium 30-80 (usually ideal), long 80+ (complex scenes). Natural language and JSON work equally well. FLUX.2 does NOT support negative prompts -- describe what you want, not what you don't. Specifying lighting has the biggest impact on quality. Typography: put text in quotes (e.g. the text "OPEN" in red neon letters), specify font style/size/placement, and tie colors to objects with hex codes (#RRGGBB); text may still be inaccurate or distorted. Distilled: 4 steps, guidance_scale 1.0.
do: Write rich natural-language prose (or JSON for production)
Put the most important subject/action first
Quote text to render and give its style/size/placement; use hex colors tied to objects
Medium length (30-80 words) is usually ideal
dont: Make vague color references not tied to an object
Bury the key subject late in the prompt
examples: A weathered fisherman mending a net on a wooden dock at golden hour, soft warm rim lighting, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 35mm film look, quiet coastal village in the background
A neon-lit ramen shop sign at night, the text "OPEN" in red neon letters glowing above the doorway, rain-slicked street reflecting the glow, cinematic, cyberpunk mood
A minimalist product poster of a glass perfume bottle on marble, elegant serif headline reading "AURA" in color #1A1A1A, large headline text top-center, soft studio lighting, high-end editorial style
prompt.negative_guidance: FLUX.2 does not support negative prompts -- describe what you want, not what you don't.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in a sentence or two, like you'd tell ChatGPT. More detail usually looks better.
